name: US ZIP Codes
description: Five-digit ZIP codes, ZIP+4 with a hyphen, without one and with spaces, ZIP codes beginning with zero, and punctuation around the last line. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
